authorization: User explicitly requested full P1, not the previous four-task/four-round pilot; compare GRPO, GiGPO, GiGPO+CTHA from the identical original model.
task_selection: Original select_games(exploratory_E4/games.json train, seed=0, iteration=0..11, count=16). Same order across arms.
loss: Unmodified native full-response token-mean PPO plus native entropy. Bypass PPO uses actual sampler denominator once, no second IS/TIS/rejection. Native GRPO/GiGPO advantages, CTHA adds only its auxiliary advantage after native GiGPO.
reward: Unmodified native ALFWorld 10*won plus invalid-format penalty0.1; CTHA labels use binary environment won only.

ctha.activation: Only all-failed current task groups, first8 steps, pooled OOF gate plus task-type-excluded stable coefficients. Current-only gate reported separately.
ctha.cold_start: Verified original768 P0 TRAIN episodes, negative iteration namespace. Historical tokens/logprobs never used for actor updates. Fit includes only this arm's latest8 TRAIN rounds and current TRAIN batch; never Tune or other arms.

gates.raw_token_absolute_errors: diagnostic only, per approved BF16 statistical protocol

initialization: Seed0 before native base/PEFT construction, fresh original model for every arm; assert initial trainable hash equals campaign reference before updates. Never initialize from R9/R14/R15 or another arm.
checkpoints: Every2 rounds, native max_actor_ckpt_to_keep=1 per arm; retain latest/final complete LoRA/model/AdamW, live hashes and checkpoint inventories for all saves. Binary tensors remain on server. Final native recovery verification queued after each arm.
execution: Serialize independent TP1 arms on this62.8GiB host. Logical64 training trajectories remain intact; generation concurrency16 only. Stop affected arm/campaign on integrity or numerical failure; no SIGSTOP, no silent restart or changed thresholds.
differences_from_old_full_p1: Same12x16x4 budget and40x2 Tune evaluation schedule, three requested arms instead of five. Native verl-agent prompts/reward/GiGPO and lr3e-6/rank64/entropy0.001/no reference KL replace the old custom trainer. Hence a new protocol, not a direct reproduction of old P1. Temperature0.7 follows full P1, changed from R14/R15 temperature1 probe and subject to unchanged full-batch gates.
reporting: Per-round per-task train/Tune outcomes, episode-weighted success, paired game bootstrap intervals, environment/response tokens, phase timing, gate and auxiliary activation counts including post-normalization and token-weighted fractions. Report steps to80% Tune or not reached. One seed/development Tune is not heldout generalization. If CTHA never activates, mark its efficacy NOT_TESTED.
publication: Register code/protocol on credit-grok before policy updates; preserve historical results. No automatic shutdown while full P1 is active.
